name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, November 8, 2023 - 6:30 p.m.
  .
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. The Public may join this meeting virtually or
 attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84060727890
  Webinar ID: 840 6072 7890
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,84060727890# OR +16699009128,,84060727890#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of October 25, 2023 Regular City Council Meeting

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Presentation to the DePippo Family - Annual Cecilia DePippo Kindness
  Award - Donation to Pancreatic Cancer Action Network

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page
1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior
to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT – EMERGENCY OPERATIONS PLAN
  AND HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN - Receive and file the October 19, 2023 Public
  Safety Committee Report.

2.  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE REPORT – MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT
  WITH HELLAS CONSTRUCTION FOR COMMUNITY PARK TURF INFILL
  REPLENISHMENT AND CEQA EXEMPTION DETERMINATION - Approve the
  maintenance agreement with Hellas Construction in the amount of $109,503 and
  authorize the City Manager to sign the agreement for replenishment of the soccer
  turf system at the Community Park.

PUBLIC HEARINGS: None

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS:  Warrants effective November 1, 2023 in the
  amount of $612,016.24.
   GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO CITY MANAGER EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT -
  Amendment No. 3 to the Employment Agreement between the City of Westlake
  Village and Robert de Geus be approved and that the Mayor be authorized to
  execute the amendment.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  AWARD CONTRACTS AND DETERMINATION FOR CEQA EXEMPTION FOR
  THE LANDSCAPE IRRIGATION CONTROLLER UPGRADE PROJECT; YEAR
  4 - SITEONE LANDSCAPE SUPPLY, AMERICAN HERITAGE LANDSCAPE
  AND ARROYO IRRIGATION - Make a CEQA Exemption determination for this
  project; approve an Irrigation Controller Purchase Agreement with SiteOne
  Landscape Supply in the amount of $76,037.60; approve a Professional Services
  Agreement with Arroyo Irrigation in the amount of $37,411.33; Approve an
  Irrigation Flow Sensor purchase agreement with American Heritage Landscape in
  the amount of $17,202 and authorize the Mayor to sign and execute the
  agreements on behalf of the City.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO PERFECTION PAINTING CORPORATION FOR
  THE FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024 CIVIC CENTER EXTERIOR PAINTING
  PROJECT - Approve a CEQA exemption determination for the Civic Center
  Exterior Painting Project; award a construction contract for the Civic Center
  Exterior Painting Project to Perfection Painting Corporation in the amount of
  $73,200.00; approve contingency and project management costs; and authorize
  the Mayor to sign and execute the construction contract on behalf of the City.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, November 2, 2023 at 5:15 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.
  City Clerk
  November 2, 2023
